thread:
alex.chang: Heads-up — merges to main are getting blocked by the pre-commit/mypy gate on CI. Noticed this after the last deploy PR. Anyone digging into the failures?

ci-bot: [ci] Job #5472 failed: pre-commit checks (mypy + black). Summary:
- mypy: 1 error in py/redwood/utils/namespace.py
- black: reformatted 3 files
- pre-commit exit code: 1
See: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/5472 

jess: I pulled the logs — mypy error looks like this:

```
py/redwood/utils/namespace.py:42: error: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type "Callable[..., Any]", variable has type "Type[Namespace]")  [assignment]
Found 1 error in 1 file (checked 120 source files)
```

jess: The change in the PR replaced a typed class with a factory function returning an instance. mypy is unhappy about assignment to a class-level variable.

dani: That was from my PR updating the namespace helper to be lazy-loaded. I can push a tiny fix — either widen the annotation to Any or change to Optional[Type[Namespace]] and cast. Prefer a minimal cast to satisfy mypy.

alex.chang: For quick unblock, is it safe to just run `pre-commit run --all-files` and `poetry run mypy py/redwood/utils/namespace.py` locally and push the fix? Or do we need a revert?

jess: Running locally should reproduce. Commands I ran:

```
git checkout HEAD~1 -- py/redwood/utils/namespace.py
pre-commit run --all-files
poetry run mypy py/redwood/utils/namespace.py --show-error-codes
```

jess: If the fix is just types and cast, a small PR is fine. If black reformatted things, include that in the same PR to keep CI green.

infra-runner: FYI there was also a transient flake in the integration suite earlier, but the current blocking failure is the typecheck. Re-run of full pipeline: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/5472/retry

dani: I'll open a tiny PR in a minute — will do a cast like `typing.cast(Type[Namespace], factory)` and add a comment.

alex.chang: Cool. If you want me to land fast, tag me and I can merge after CI passes. Also please add a changelog line if this changes public helpers.

jess: Another note — our mypy config recently tightened `disallow-untyped-defs` for that folder. If the change introduced any untyped helper functions, mypy will error elsewhere. I ran full mypy and got the single error above.

dani: pushing branch now -> https://git.internal/redwood/infra/compare/fix/mypy-namespace-174953.json

dani: PR opened, small change, added `# type: ignore[arg-type]` on one line and a short comment explaining factory->class assignment.

ci-bot: PR 4128 created by dani. Running pre-commit checks.

infra-runner: I'm going to trigger a focused rerun of the typecheck job to save cycles: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/5472/rerun-partial?target=mypy

alex.chang: Thanks — please ping when CI is green. If re-runs fail again, we should consider a temporary CI bypass for urgent releases, but prefer a proper type fix.

jess: If anyone else hits this locally, quick repro is:

```
# from repo root
pip install -e .
pre-commit run --all-files
poetry run mypy py/redwood/utils/namespace.py
```

jess: And `git --no-pager show :py/redwood/utils/namespace.py` to inspect staged changes if a pre-commit hook reformats unexpectedly.

dani: CI red -> fixed on my branch, pre-commit/black reformats included. I'll @alex.chang once the runner finishes.

ci-bot: Job 5480 (mypy) succeeded for PR 4128.

alex.chang: Green — merging now. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround :rocket:

jess: Nice. Follow-up: let's add a short note in the dev docs about migrating class->factory patterns so future PRs include the right types. I can draft.

dani: Will follow up with a small doc patch.

alex.chang: End of thread.
